northStar: Practice clips where the tool's feedback matches the teacher's own judgement, out of fifty clips from five students.
buildExpectation: Support one instrument or vocal style, collect fifty real practice clips from five students and have their teacher mark the feedback right or wrong.
note: North star swapped from session counts to feedback accuracy a student can measure in two weeks against a real teacher's marking.

northStar: Essays that a counsellor scores higher on a rubric after two rounds of feedback, out of ten applicants.
buildExpectation: Run two rounds of essay feedback with ten real applicants and have one counsellor score the drafts before and after.
note: Old north star depended on application deadlines outside the 17 days; replaced with rubric movement the student can observe.

buildExpectation: Run training and committee setup for one real company with at least ten employees.
problem: India's law on prevention of sexual harassment at work, the POSH Act, requires every workplace with ten or more employees to set up an internal committee, train staff and file annual reports. Many small and mid-size companies haven't done this properly, and the penalties and reputational risk are real.
note: Expanded POSH on first use; north star already passes with ten or more employees so only the pilot size is pinned.

Cut: the Individualized Education Program is a US statutory process, a student in India has no route to a real parent or meeting, and relocating the pilot removes the legal frame the problem rests on.
Cut: no route to real Nigerian exam candidates in 17 days, and relocating the pilot to India makes it a thin duplicate of P059 and P063.

northStar: Band score gain in speaking and writing across fifteen learners after two weeks, marked against the official rubric.
buildExpectation: Take fifteen real learners through two weeks of practice and have a trainer mark their first and last attempts.
note: Shortened the measurement window from three weeks to two so the gain lands inside day 17.

northStar: Share of last year's dropouts the score flags correctly on one institute's past batch.
buildExpectation: Score one institute's past batch against what actually happened, then run counsellor follow-ups with a live batch for two weeks.
note: Old north star needed eight weeks of enrolment; promoted the back-test accuracy already implied in the build expectation.
Cut: proving behaviour change needs corporate L&D sponsorship and employee performance data a student cannot get, and the role-play assessment left over duplicates P103.

northStar: Rupee value of unclaimed stipend reimbursement found across three employers' apprentice records.
buildExpectation: Audit apprentice and stipend records at three real employers and hand each one a completed claim pack.
note: Reimbursement depends on a government payment cycle, so the north star now measures claimable value found, not money received.
North star and build already measurable with one real class inside two weeks; mechanic only.

northStar: Rupee margin the hedging rule would have protected across ten of one trader's past shipments.
buildExpectation: Map one trader's real currency exposure from their open invoices and back-test the rules on ten shipments they already settled.
note: Pinned the north star to ten past shipments so it is a back-test the student can run, not a future margin.

northStar: Landed-cost estimates within ten percent of the charges actually paid, across twenty past US shipments.
buildExpectation: Calculate landed cost for twenty real products from one seller and compare with the duty and fees on their actual shipments.
note: Delivery outcomes need a shipping cycle; promoted the landed-cost accuracy check already in the build expectation.

northStar: Rupee value of overdue invoices that buyers give a dated payment commitment on, across three suppliers in two weeks.
buildExpectation: Map three real MSMEs' receivables and run the buyer follow-ups with them for two weeks.
problem: MSME suppliers to large companies often wait 90 days or more for payment. Section 43B(h) of the Income Tax Act pushes buyers to pay registered micro and small suppliers within 45 days, and TReDS, the RBI-licensed platforms for discounting approved invoices, lets suppliers get paid early, yet few suppliers use either well.
constraints: Fear of upsetting big customers, whether the supplier is registered on Udyam, the government's MSME register, and not legal advice.
note: Expanded TReDS and Udyam, and replaced a days-to-payment metric that waits on a corporate payment cycle with dated commitments obtained.

northStar: Share of fifty real PDF invoices converted into structured form that pass the format validation rules.
buildExpectation: Convert fifty real PDF invoices from two Indian SMEs already under GST e-invoicing, check them against the validation rules, and review the output with one UAE accountant online.
constraints: Peppol and PINT AE, the UAE's national invoice data standards, transmission through accredited providers, and rules that may still change.
note: Pilot relocated to Indian SMEs under GST e-invoicing because there is no route to a real UAE SME; UAE framing kept in the problem, PINT AE expanded, and the 'real or realistic' hatch removed.

buildExpectation: Parse ten real policies and test the explanations with the ten people who hold them.
note: North star passes; only pinned the build expectation to the ten real policyholders.

northStar: Rupees ten workers set aside as a buffer over two weeks of using the tool.
buildExpectation: Interview fifteen real gig workers, analyse their consented earnings data and run the tool with ten of them for two weeks.
note: Old north star waited for an expense spike to occur; replaced with money actually set aside, which the student can count.
Cut: paying a bill on a recipient's behalf across borders needs a payment licence or a licensed partner, and a student in India has no route to diaspora senders or merchant settlement.

buildExpectation: Run one real savings group's contributions and payouts through the product for two weeks, with at least five members.
note: North star passes; replaced the open-ended 'a cycle' with two weeks and five members.

northStar: Forecast error against the balances that actually happened, across five businesses' past bank statements.
buildExpectation: Back-test the forecast on six months of real statements from five businesses and check the misses with each owner.
note: A 13-week forecast cannot be scored by day 17, so it is now a back-test against banked history with five businesses.
Passes as is: ten real older adults, observable in one sitting; role-play is the only ethical way to test and is kept.

northStar: Rupee value of unclaimed input tax credit found across five real businesses.
buildExpectation: Reconcile one month of purchase records against the portal statement for five real businesses and quantify the missing credit with their accountant.
problem: Indian businesses can claim GST input tax credit only when their suppliers file returns correctly. Small businesses rarely reconcile their purchase records against GSTR-2B, the monthly statement the GST portal generates of credit their suppliers have actually reported, so credits slip away and notices arrive later.
note: Expanded GSTR-2B, and changed the north star from credit recovered, which needs a supplier to file, to credit found across five businesses.

northStar: Rupee tax saving a CA confirms across ten real NRI cases.
buildExpectation: Map obligations for ten real NRI cases with their consent and have a CA check each one.
note: Refunds take months, so the north star is now the saving a CA signs off on, and the cases must be real rather than scenarios.

constraints: Insurance regulation, affordability, and basis risk, the gap between what the weather trigger pays and what the worker actually lost.
note: Expanded basis risk; the back-tested north star already passes.
Cut: recurring debits on Pix need a Brazilian payment provider the students cannot sign, the build expectation rested on sandbox simulation, and there is no route to a real Brazilian merchant.

northStar: Readiness gaps found for five real MSMEs that a banker agrees would have stalled the file.
buildExpectation: Run readiness checks on five real MSMEs' GST, bank and tax records and have a working banker mark each gap right or wrong.
note: Approval rate waits on a lender's credit cycle; the north star is now gaps a banker confirms in a single sitting.
Cut: the build expectation only worked on synthetic statements, and no business family will hand a student their full multi-generation holdings inside 17 days.

northStar: Rupee difference in true cost the comparison exposes across ten real loan offers.
buildExpectation: Read ten real Key Fact Statements from borrowers' own offers and compare the true cost with what each borrower believed they were paying.
note: Old north star depended on which loan the borrower chose; now it is the cost gap the tool exposes on ten real offers.

northStar: Hours five NGOs spend producing one CSR report, with and without the template.
buildExpectation: Profile twenty real NGOs in one cause area from public filings, and time the reporting template with five of them.
note: North star given an n of five NGOs so the hours saved are a comparison, not a single anecdote.

northStar: Customers who reply to a renewal follow-up from one agent's real book in two weeks, out of fifty policies due.
buildExpectation: Load one real agent's book of at least fifty policies and run the renewal follow-ups with them for two weeks.
note: Renewal rate needs a policy year to play out, so the north star is now replies to follow-ups on policies already due.

northStar: Value of forgotten assets found across five real families' searches.
buildExpectation: Run searches and build claim checklists for five real families, with their consent.
note: Claims take institutions months, so the north star now stops at value found, which the student sees the same day.

northStar: Discrepancies in ten real document sets that an experienced banker or forwarder confirms are genuine.
buildExpectation: Check ten real letter of credit document sets shared by two exporters or freight forwarders and have one of them mark every flag right or wrong.
constraints: Document variety, bank confidentiality, and interpreting UCP 600, the international banking rules used to judge letter of credit documents.
note: Removed the 'real or realistic' hatch, expanded UCP 600, and replaced a bank presentation outcome with flags an expert confirms.

northStar: New workers who pass a supervisor's task check at the end of their first week, out of ten hires.
buildExpectation: Pilot with ten new hires at one factory or warehouse for two weeks and have their supervisor run the task check.
note: Thirty-day retention cannot be seen by day 17; replaced with a first-week competence check the supervisor scores.
Days-to-complete-set is observable across twenty real clients inside the pilot; mechanic only.
North star already scored by a lawyer's check on twenty real contracts; mechanic only.

northStar: Diligence gaps found per startup across three real startups, confirmed by their CA or company secretary.
buildExpectation: Run a diligence-readiness audit on three real startups' records and have each one's company secretary verify the findings.
note: Days from term sheet to closing depends on an investor's timeline; replaced with verified gaps found across three startups.

northStar: Notices a lawyer signs off as ready to send without rewriting, out of five real cases.
buildExpectation: Take five real bounced-cheque cases through the notice stage with a practising lawyer reviewing each draft.
note: Payment within 30 days falls outside the window; the north star is now lawyer sign-off on five real notices.

northStar: Partner review time per draft across ten real drafts, against the firm's usual time.
buildExpectation: Generate ten drafts of one document type from a real firm's own precedents and time the partner's review against their usual process.
note: Gave the north star an n of ten drafts so the time saving is measured, not claimed.

northStar: Share of five hundred real transactions categorised correctly with no human correction.
buildExpectation: Catch up three months of books for one real business and have their bookkeeper correct every miscategorised transaction.
note: Hours-to-close on one business was an n of one; replaced with categorisation accuracy over five hundred real transactions.
Median reply time over two weeks of a real inbox already passes; mechanic only.

northStar: Rupee value of unclaimed incentives found across six months of one exporter's shipping bills.
buildExpectation: Review six months of real shipping bills for one exporter and have their customs broker confirm what was left unclaimed.
problem: Indian exporters are entitled to duty refunds and incentives such as drawback and RoDTEP, the scheme that refunds embedded taxes on exported goods, but small exporters often miss claims or file late. The paperwork across shipping bills and portals is tedious.
note: Expanded RoDTEP, and changed the north star from value claimed, which waits on a portal and a credit cycle, to value found and confirmed.

buildExpectation: Match one hundred real invoices, purchase orders and goods receipts from one company and have their AP team check the exceptions.
note: Removed the 'anonymised' hatch and required real matched document sets from a live AP team.
Visits logged within a day across five or more real reps already passes; mechanic only.

buildExpectation: Score fifty real calls from one support team against their own rubric and compare with their QA team's scores.
note: Removed the 'real or licensed' hatch; agreement with human QA on fifty real calls is observable in the window.

northStar: Verified worker profiles a lender or landlord rates as usable proof in a review session, out of ten.
buildExpectation: Build verified profiles for ten real workers from their platform exports and sit with one lender, landlord or employer to rate each one.
note: Acceptance decisions sit in a credit queue, so the north star is now a same-day rating of ten profiles by a real gatekeeper.

northStar: Intro calls both sides rate as worth a second meeting, out of ten matches.
buildExpectation: Match ten real MSMEs with retired experts, run the intro calls and collect a rating from both sides.
note: A paid engagement needs the MSME's own budget cycle; replaced with rated intro calls across ten matches.

buildExpectation: Onboard ten real vendors for one company through the flow, including the GST, PAN and bank checks.
note: Removed the 'real or realistic' hatch; days from invite to approval across ten real vendors is observable in two weeks.
Verified share of billed guard hours over a two-week pilot already passes; mechanic only.

northStar: First-time fix rate across twenty real jobs during the pilot.
buildExpectation: Support one appliance category with one service business for two weeks, covering at least twenty real jobs.
note: Gave the north star an explicit job count so the rate is not read off two or three visits.
Cut: a thin sibling of P065, which already covers US cross-border tax and landed cost for small Indian sellers with a stronger, document-based build.

buildExpectation: Turn one real SOP into multilingual training and test it with ten frontline staff at an Indian hotel, restaurant or retail chain, with a supervisor running the practical check.
note: Pilot relocated to an Indian hospitality or retail floor because there is no route to real UAE frontline staff; the Gulf framing stays in the problem.
Cut: the build expectation rested on realistic sample books, real US client ledgers are closed to students, and what remains duplicates P091's bookkeeping accuracy work.

northStar: Share of one hundred real questionnaire questions answered with a citation the founder accepts without edits.
buildExpectation: Answer two real security questionnaires for two startups from their own policies, with citations, and have each founder mark every answer.
note: Removed the 'real or sample' hatch and replaced turnaround days with answer-level accuracy the founder scores.

northStar: Sizing and payback estimates for ten real homes that an empanelled installer agrees with.
buildExpectation: Size systems for ten real homes from their electricity bills and have one empanelled installer and the homeowners check each estimate.
constraints: Net-metering processes differ by state DISCOM, the local electricity distribution company, installer quality varies, and roofs need shading checks.
note: Expanded DISCOM, and replaced signed installations, which wait on subsidy and utility approval, with installer-verified sizing and payback.
